Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead found; Dnipro is not occupied. Operating-status leads: an annual activity report for 2024 (academic year 2023–2024) is published on the official site (PDF uploaded 2025-03: https://dimh.kmu.edu.ua/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/richnyj-zvit_2024.pdf), and education.ua shows 2024–2025 rating data. CONTRADICTION to check: the osvita.ua aggregator card (https://osvita.ua/vnz/guide/37133/) says 'сьогодні ДІМЗ успішно працює у серці Поділля — у місті Вінниця' while naming the institute 'Дніпровський'; this looks like an aggregator copy error but the actual licensed place of activity (Dnipro vs Vinnytsia) is unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Legal identity vs Kyiv Medical University (inventory slug kyiv-medical-university) unexplained: the site is a KMU subdomain (dimh.kmu.edu.ua), the International Department e-mail is dimh@kmu.edu.ua, KMU's 2021 recognition PDF (kmu.edu.ua/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/viznannya.pdf) lists the Dnipro institute alongside Kharkiv and Kyiv, and KMU's 2022 brochure says 'campuses in KYIV | KHARKIV | DNIPRO'. Whether ДІМЗ is a separate licensed ПЗВО or a structural unit/campus of KMU (and whose licence covers its programmes) is unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: osvita.ua card says the institute 'працює ... у місті Вінниця' while the name says Dnipro — place of licensed activity contradiction (likely aggregator error, unverified).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion risk: distinct from the state Dnipro State Medical University (listed slug dnipro-state-medical-university) and from the private Dnipro Medical Institute of Traditional and Non-traditional Medicine (inventory slug dnipro-medical-institute-of-conventional-and-alternative-medicine); search results for the English name mostly return those two institutions.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The only foreign-intake lead is a 2022 announcement and a 2021 study-programme PDF stated to be 'valid only until 2023/2024' — no current (2025/2026) admission rules for foreigners found; do not present these as current.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The 'medicine program accredited by a German agency in 2021' claim (dimh.kmu.edu.ua/?p=3089) is a foreign/private accreditation lead, not Ukrainian NAQA accreditation; NAQA listing not found. Keep registration, licence, accreditation and recognition separate.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Young institution (founded 2018 per osvita.ua) with no EDEBO/NAQA listing found and no EDRPOU code located — programme licence and accreditation status entirely unverified.
